name: Sarick Quillbonk Xobar Stoutboots Jetor Squiggledust
equipment: Specialist Barbarian Armour (13 + Str mod = 16 AC)
Stone Heart Amulet (+4 temp HP while raging — from his elder/mentor)
Explorer's Pack (backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 rations, waterskin, 50ft rope)
Rock Necklace (made by Dwayne — identifies real Sarick from fakes)
Kraken's Kiss Dark Rum (gives gills for 10 minutes)
Half Price Potion (roll d100 for effect)

spellcasting.name: Rune: Stone Rune (Giant Foundling)
spellcasting.desc: While wearing/carrying the inscribed object: advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks and darkvision 120 ft. Reaction: when a creature ends its turn within 30 ft, force Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (speed 0, incapacitated, dreamy stupor) for 1 minute. Repeats save each turn. Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d12+2 slashing. While raging: 1d12+4 slashing.

actions.name: Stone Throw (Keenness of the Stone Giant)
actions.desc: Ranged spell attack, range 60 ft. On a hit: 1d10 force damage + DC [8+PB+Str mod] Strength saving throw or Prone. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.

actions.name: Reckless Attack
actions.desc: On first attack each turn, choose to gain advantage on all Str-based melee attacks this turn. Until next turn, attacks against Sarick also have advantage.

class_features.name: Rage (3/long rest)
class_features.desc: Bonus action to enter rage. While raging: advantage on Str checks and Str saves; +2 damage on Str melee attacks; resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Ends if no attack/damage since last turn or falls unconscious. 3 uses at level 4.

class_features.name: Reckless Attack
class_features.desc: Advantage on all Str melee attacks this turn. Attackers also have advantage against Sarick until his next turn.

class_features.name: Danger Sense
class_features.desc: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects he can see (traps, spells). Not while blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

class_features.name: Path of the Berserker: Frenzy
class_features.desc: When raging, Sarick can choose to frenzy. For the rage's duration, he can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action each turn after the first. When rage ends, he suffers one level of Exhaustion. Use carefully.

class_features.name: Unarmored Defense
class_features.desc: Without armor: AC = 10 + Dex mod (-1) + Con mod (+1) = 10. Currently using Specialist Barbarian Armour (13 + Str mod +3 = 16 AC).

class_features.name: Keenness of the Stone Giant (Feat)
class_features.desc: +1 Str (included). Darkvision extended by 60 ft (now 120 ft total). Stone Throw: bonus action, ranged spell attack 60 ft, 1d10 force + Prone on failed Str save. Uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.

class_features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
class_features.desc: +1 Str, +1 Con from ASI (reflected in current stats).

traits.name: Rock Gnome
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft (extended to 120 ft by feat and Stone Rune). Gnome Cunning: advantage on Int/Wis/Cha saving throws against magic. Artificer's Lore: double proficiency on History checks about magic, tech, or alchemy. Tinker: construct tiny clockwork devices.

traits.name: Giant Foundling (Background)
traits.desc: Raised among giants. Skill proficiencies: Intimidation, Survival. Grants the Strike of the Giants feat at character creation. Origin: likely found/raised by stone giants.

traits.name: Personality
traits.desc: Curious and inquisitive. Easily distracted. Is an angry dude.

traits.name: Special Notes
traits.desc: 🍳🥓 Bonus action for +4 temp HP (cooking related). Has 1 free Inspiration+ for slicing an enemy in half. Stone Heart Amulet gives +4 temp HP while raging. Temp +2 AC available from some source. Augury available as ritual via class access.

goals: Honour his giant mentor (Stone Heart Amulet)
backstory: A Rock Gnome barbarian raised among giants. The Stone Heart Amulet was given to him by his previous elder or mentor. He wears a Rock Necklace made by Dwayne so others can tell the real Sarick from any impersonators. Curious, easily distracted, but with a deep anger underneath.
notes: Level 4 update: Str increased to 14 (+2), Con 13 (+1). AC is 16 using Specialist Barbarian Armour (scales with Str mod). Currently at 24/30 HP with 4 temp HP from Stone Heart Amulet. Has Frenzy available — warn player about the Exhaustion cost each use. Stone Throw is a bonus action ranged attack, uses per long rest = proficiency bonus (2). Stone Rune reaction is very powerful — charmed + incapacitated + speed 0. Rage uses: 3 per long rest at level 4.
